_help: Edit this file to change the ads; the app picks up changes within a minute, no restart needed. 'image' is optional: a full https:// address, or a file name inside server/data/ad-images/. Leave 'url' empty for an ad that is not a link. Colours are any CSS colour. 'weight' makes an ad show more often (default 1). Set 'active': false to pause an ad.
